picks.name: Better Sweater Fleece Jacket, Marlow Brown Rib Knit
picks.why: There's still no fleece, so the hiking, lounging and outdoor outfits have no mid-layer. This is a trim full-zip in a ribbed sweater-knit fleece with raglan sleeves, brown with only a small chest label, so it reads more knit than gilet. Wear it over a grey marl tee with the 502s and the Sambas, or under the waxed Ashby on the coast path.

picks.name: Shetland Jumper, Denim Dark
picks.why: The office and travel outfits still have no knit. This is a 4-ply Shetland wool crew knitted in Hawick, with a saddle shoulder that sits neatly rather than boxy, long ribbed cuffs and no branding, in a washed denim marl that adds texture without pattern. Wear it over a charcoal tee with the fawn chinos and brown Docs, or with the 502s and Sambas at the weekend.

picks.name: Short Sleeve T-Shirt, Charcoal
picks.why: Tees are still the biggest gap and every formula starts with one. This is a plain, regular-fit organic cotton crew made in the UK, charcoal with no logo, so it layers under the Shetland crew, the raglan sweats or the fleece. Wear it with the navy chinos and Vans, or the 502s and the waxed Ashby.
